title: Holiday gift cards for staff count as pay

beats.text: A gift card "no matter how little": wages or a small perk?
Gift cards and cash are *always wages*.

captions.instagram:
Quiz: you hand each employee a gift card for the holidays. Taxable?
Yes. The IRS says cash and cash equivalents like gift cards, no matter how little, are never a de minimis perk. They are wages and go through payroll.

✔️ Gift cards or cash to staff: wages.
✔️ A holiday ham, turkey or fruit basket now and then: usually a small de minimis perk.
✔️ A holiday party for the team: a business expense.
✔️ Gifts to clients: you can deduct no more than $25 per person for the year.

Planning gifts this year? Decide before payroll closes in December.

Source: IRS Publication 15-B; Publication 463. General information, not advice for your situation.
